lc_person: Patrick Wright, cartoonist and painter (1945–1993 in LC); author of Walkies.
item_person: Patrick Wright, historian and writer (born 1951 in Wikidata), affiliated with King’s College London; author of On Living in an Old Country and Iron Curtain.

evidence.says: LC cites Walkies (copyright 1982) and a British Museum biography identifying a cartoonist and painter. Its structured dates give birth year 1945 and death year 1993; its variant heading is Wright, Patrick, 1945-1993. It nevertheless links Q7147865 as a close external authority.
Identifies Patrick Wright as a cartoonist and painter/draughtsman, gives life years 1945–1993, and names Walkies as his first book.

Identifies a historian born in 1951, with King’s College London and Nottingham Trent University as employers. Its birth year cites BnF authority 16509750h. It carries LC identifier n82269682, VIAF 25968542 and ISNI 0000000119477886.
The graph’s exact Open Library author ID describes Patrick Wright as a historian and gives birth year 1951.

Lists On Living in an Old Country, Passport to Peking, Iron Curtain, The Village That Died for England and A Journey Through Ruins, but also includes Walkies, indicating mixed attribution within this author record.

Identifies Patrick Wright as an emeritus professor at King’s College London, formerly at Nottingham Trent University. Lists On Living in an Old Country, Iron Curtain, Passport to Peking and A Journey Through Ruins, corroborating the historian represented by the graph’s Open Library record.

notes: Distinct people, rather than a birth-year typo. The graph’s Open Library biography and principal historical works fit the Wikidata historian; LC’s source notes fit the cartoonist. Shared cross-references do not resolve this conflict. No separate Wikidata item for the LC cartoonist was verified. Birth-year reconciliation is inapplicable because the identities differ. LC HTML was inaccessible; its official MADS/RDF JSON was read.
